summary: Allow verified email links to establish managed Cloud sessions and protect link requests with optional Turnstile verification.
userImpact: An account can sign in by email link and add a passkey afterward.
Email signup refuses known disposable email domains.
configuration: Set EG_CLOUD_EMAIL_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY and EG_CLOUD_EMAIL_TURNSTILE_SECRET together to enable server verification.
Set EG_FRONTEND_CLOUD_EMAIL_TURNSTILE_ENABLED=true on the matching frontend image.
Set cloudEmailSignupProtection.enabled, siteKey and the dedicated secret reference in split-runtime Helm deployments.

changes: Adds public email challenge configuration and an email proof completion endpoint.
Adds an optional passkey registration flow for verified Cloud email sessions.

security: Email proofs and Turnstile tokens are single-use.
Administrator eligibility is rechecked for email-only sessions.
rollback: Restore the prior host and frontend together.
validation: Targeted authentication, frontend, deployment and PostgreSQL isolation tests passed.
